blocks.text: 17th sadi (century) ke shuru mein bohat se scientists ne bohat chhoti cheezen dekhne ke liye microscope istemal karna shuru kiya. 1665 mein English scientist Robert Hooke ne oak ke darakht ke cork ka ek patla tukra (slice) microscope ke neeche dekha. Us ne dekha ke cork "bohat se chhote dabbon" (many little boxes) se bana hai. Hooke ne oak ke tanay (stem) aur jar (root) ke tukre bhi dekhe; woh bhi aise hi chhote dabbon se bane the. Us ne nateeja nikala ke poday ke hisse chhote khanon (compartments) se bane hain, aur in khanon ka naam "cellulae" rakha.

blocks.alt: Robert Hooke ki microscope ki drawing: gol base par khambe ke saath laga hua lamba tircha tube, aur objective wale sire ke neeche pin par cork ka tukra. Saath hi cork ki patli qash (slice) ka gol manzar jis mein bohat se chhote, band, dabba numa cells hain jin ki deewarein sanjhi hain.

blocks.text: 1673 mein Dutch scientist Anton van Leeuwenhoek ne behtar microscope banaya aur talaab ke pani mein zinda cells dekhe. Us ne in cells ko animalcules (nanhe janwar) kaha.

1809 mein French biologist Jean Baptiste de-Lamarck ne bhi janwaron aur podon ke hisse microscope se dekhte hue cells dekhe. Phir 1831 mein British botanist (podon ka mahir) Robert Brown ne cell mein nucleus daryaft kiya.

In studies ke baad biologists ne cells ki maloomat ko tarteeb dena shuru kiya. 1838 mein German botanist Matthias Schleiden ne podon ke bohat se hisse microscope se dekhe aur nateeja nikala ke tamam poday cells se bane hain. Agle saal German zoologist (janwaron ka mahir) Theodor Schwann ne janwaron ke liye yehi nateeja nikala. 1855 mein German physician Rudolf Virchow (1821–1902) ne dekha ke tamam cells doosre cells se aate hain. 1862 mein Louis Pasteur ne is khayal ka experimental saboot (tajurbe se saboot) diya. In observations (mushahidon) ko mila kar cells ke bare mein ek bunyadi theory bani jise cell theory kehte hain. Is ke teen zaroori nuqte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Virchow ka saal 1885 likhti hai. Yeh sahi nahi ho sakta, kyun ke isi khayal ka Pasteur wala saboot 1862 ka hai. Virchow ne "har cell kisi cell se aata hai" (omnis cellula e cellula) 1855 mein kaha tha.

items: Tamam jandar ek ya zyada cells se bane hain.
Cells kisi jandar mein structure (banawat) aur function (kaam) ki basic units hain.
Cells sirf pehle se maujood (pre-existing) cells ki division (taqseem) se bante hain.
